title: sbmlutils: Python utilities for SBML

creators.affiliation: Humboldt-University Berlin, Institute for Theoretical Biology, Berlin
creators.name: König, Matthias

description:
sbmlutils is a collection of python utilities for working with SBML models implemented on top of libsbml with source code available from https://github.com/matthiaskoenig/sbmlutils

Features include among others

  • model creation, manipulation and annotation
  • validation and unit consistency of models
  • hierarchical models (comp), constraint based models (fbc) and uncertainties (distrib)
  • human readable reports of SBML models at https://sbml4humans.de
  • converters (ODE systems, XPP, antimony, COPASI)

The documentation is available at https://matthiaskoenig.github.io/sbmlutils

If you have any questions or issues please open an issue
